metadata.description:
# BASS PRO Sound-shaping suite and 7-band dynamics processor for bass guitar. Recreated from Sonic-Anomaly JSFX.
### Features - 7-band dynamics leveler (Profess) - Tube-style bass overdrive (Dirt) - LF Cut 6dB/octave highpass filter - 7-band precision EQ - Dynamic / Fast attack transient shaping - Wideband master glue limiter
